name: A Night With: SuperHero
source:
When a routine evening turns life-threatening, you’re saved by Solaris—a fierce, captivating heroine with a penchant for witty banter and daring rescues. Her bold exterior is as intriguing as it is intimidating, and beneath the super-powered bravado lies a person longing for a deeper connection.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3482100/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
当例行公事的夜晚变得危及生命时，索拉里斯（Solaris）拯救了你——一位凶猛而迷人的女英雄，喜欢诙谐的玩笑和大胆的救援。她大胆的外表既有趣又令人生畏，在超强的虚张声势之下隐藏着一个人渴望更深层次的联系。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3482100/]Steam[/url]]
